dataset_source: UCI Machine Learning Repository - Indian Liver Patient Dataset (ILPD)
split_strategy: Stratified 80/20 hold-out; model chosen only on the 80% dev partition via CV.

cleaning.missing_value_handling: A/G Ratio missing values imputed with the training-fold median inside the pipeline; Gender missing values imputed with the training-fold mode.
cleaning.duplicate_policy: Exact duplicate rows removed before splitting so identical records cannot appear in both train and test (ILPD has no patient id).

preprocessing: ColumnTransformer: numeric -> SimpleImputer(median) + StandardScaler; categorical(Gender) -> SimpleImputer(most_frequent) + OneHotEncoder. Fitted inside the pipeline on training folds only.
imbalance_handling: class_weight (None vs 'balanced') is a tuned hyper-parameter chosen by CV per family. The operating threshold is left at 0.5; a dev-only precision/recall/Youden sweep is published but not used for tuning because it is unstable on 583 rows. No synthetic oversampling (SMOTE).
hyperparameter_search: GridSearchCV over StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, seed) per family, scoring=roc_auc.

model_selection.rule: max DEV CV ROC-AUC, then simplest family within 0.01 ROC-AUC of the best

limitations: ILPD is a single-region (Andhra Pradesh, India) dataset of 583 records; it under-represents women and non-Indian populations.
Labels indicate prior clinical grouping, not a specific liver disease or severity.
Permutation importance describes model behaviour, not physiological causation.
disclaimer: Educational and research use only. This estimates a risk pattern learned from a public dataset and is not a medical diagnosis.
